title: Crisp Venezuelan Lettuce Salad
description: A refreshing salad inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, featuring crisp lettuce and a variety of textures.
instructions: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves.
Cut the corn kernels from the cobs.
Cut the avocado and tomato into small pieces.
Toss the pumpkin seeds in a pan and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the lettuce, corn, avocado, tomato, and pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
